entries.source:
Make the movement of creatures and projectiles 'smooth'. When set to 0 movement will be instantaneous.
The higher this value the slower the movements will appear.

Note: This does not affect the turn-based idea of the game. You can move again while your character is still moving, and it will correctly update and compute a new animation.
entries.target:
令生物和抛射物的移动更加平滑。设置为0时，移动看起来是瞬间完成的。
数值越高，画面显示的移动速度越慢。

注意：这并不会改变该游戏的回合制机制。你可以在角色仍在移动时再次移动，游戏会正确更新并计算新的动画。

entries.source:
Enables smooth fog-of-war.
Disabling it will make the fog of war look 'blocky' but might gain a slight performance increase.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启平滑战争迷雾。
关闭它会让战争迷雾看起来呈方块状，但可能会略微提升性能。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Select the HUD look. 'Minimalist' is the default one.
#LIGHT_RED#This will take effect on next restart.
entries.target:
选择 HUD 风格。默认为“精简”。
#LIGHT_RED#重启游戏后生效。

entries.source: When you activate a hotkey, either by keyboard or click a visual feedback will appear over it in the hotkeys bar.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你通过键盘或鼠标点击激活快捷键时，快捷栏中对应的格子上会出现视觉反馈。#WHITE#

entries.source: Toggles between a normal or flagpost tactical bars.#WHITE#
entries.target: 战术视图切换：正常或者旗杆。#WHITE#

entries.source: Toggles between a bottom or side display for tactial healthbars.#WHITE#
entries.target: 血条位置切换：侧边或者底部#WHITE#

entries.source: If disabled you will not get a fullscreen notification of stun/daze effects. Beware.#WHITE#
entries.target: 如果关闭，当被震慑或眩晕时，你不会得到全屏效果提示。当心。#WHITE#

entries.source: If disabled you will not get a fullscreen notification of confusion effects. Beware.#WHITE#
entries.target: 如果关闭，当混乱时你不会得到全屏效果提示。当心。#WHITE#
切换高级武器数据显示。#WHITE#

entries.source: Always display the combat properties of gloves even if you don't know unarmed attack talents.#WHITE#
entries.target: 永远显示手套的战斗数据，不管你有没有学会徒手攻击技能。#WHITE#

entries.source: Always display combat properties of shields even if you don't know shield attack talents.#WHITE#
entries.target: 永远显示盾牌的战斗数据，不管你有没有学会盾牌攻击技能。#WHITE#

entries.source: When you do a mouse gesture (right click + drag) a color coded trail is displayed.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你用右键拖动画出鼠标手势时，会显示彩色的轨迹提示。#WHITE#

entries.source: If enabled new quests and quests updates will display a big popup, if not a simple line of text will fly on the screen.#WHITE#
entries.target: 如果开启，新任务和任务更新会以大弹窗显示；如果关闭，只会有一行文字在屏幕上飘过。#WHITE#

entries.source: Enable the WASD movement keys. Can be used to move diagonaly by pressing two directions at once.#WHITE#
entries.target: 启用 WASD 键移动。当你同时按两个键的时候，可以实现对角线移动。#WHITE#

entries.source: Sharpen Visuals, set to 0 to disable.#WHITE#
Defines the distance from the screen edge at which scrolling will start. If set high enough the game will always center on the player.#WHITE#
entries.target: 定义人物距屏幕边缘多远时开始滚屏。设置得足够高的话，画面会始终以人物为中心。#WHITE#

entries.source: If you lose more than this percentage of life in a turn, a warning will display and all key/mouse input will be ignored for 2 seconds to prevent mistakes.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你在一回合内损失了超过该百分比的生命时，将弹出提醒并暂时关闭鼠标、键盘操作2秒。#WHITE#

entries.source: Life lost percentage (out of max life)
entries.target: 生命损失百分比（占最大生命值）

entries.source:
Enables or disables weather effects in some zones.
Disabling it can gain some performance. It will not affect previously visited zones.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启/关闭天气效果。
关闭它可能提升性能。不影响已经去过的区域。#WHITE#

entries.source: Enables or disables day/night light variations effects..#WHITE#
entries.target: 开启/关闭昼夜光照变化效果#WHITE#

entries.source: Enables easy movement using the mouse by left-clicking on the map.#WHITE#
entries.target: 开启鼠标左键点击地图快速移动。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Enables quick melee targeting.
Talents that require a melee target will automatically target when pressing a direction key instead of requiring a confirmation.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启快捷近战目标选定。
使用近战攻击技能时，可以用方向键指定目标，无需确认。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Enables quick melee targeting auto attacking.
Talents that require a melee target will automatically target and confirm if there is only one hostile creature around.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启快捷近战目标自动选定。
使用近战攻击技能时，若只有一个临近敌对目标，则自动攻击这个目标。#WHITE#

entries.source: Enables mouse targeting. If disabled mouse movements will not change the target when casting a spell or using a talent.#WHITE#
entries.target: 开启鼠标指定目标功能。如果关闭，技能指定目标时不受鼠标移动影响。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Auto-validate targets. If you fire an arrow/talent/... it will automatically use the default target without asking
#LIGHT_RED#This is dangerous. Do not enable unless you know exactly what you are doing.#WHITE#

Default target is always either one of:
 - The last creature hovered by the mouse
 - The last attacked creature
 - The closest creature
entries.target:
自动选择目标。使用技能、装备等时不再要求指定目标。
#LIGHT_RED#注意：这非常危险。除非你确切知道自己在做什么，否则不要启用。#WHITE#

默认目标会遵循以下规则选择：
 - 最后一个鼠标划过的目标。
 - 最后一个攻击的目标
 - 最近的目标

entries.source: New games begin with some talent points auto-assigned.#WHITE#
entries.target: 新游戏开始时部分技能点自动分配。#WHITE#

entries.source: Always rest to full before auto-exploring.#WHITE#
entries.target: 自动探索前休息至尽可能满状态。#WHITE#

entries.source: When swapping an item with a tinker attached, swap the tinker to the newly worn item automatically.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当切换一件带有附着物的装备时，自动将附着物切换至新装备上。#WHITE#

entries.source: Configure the chat filters to select what kind of messages to see.#WHITE#
entries.target: 设置聊天信息过滤器，选择接受信息的类型。#WHITE#

entries.source: Configure the chat channels to listen to.#WHITE#
entries.target: 设置聊天信息接受频道。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Open links in external browser instead of the embedded one.
This does not affect addons browse and installation which always stays ingame.
entries.target:
点击超链接时用外部浏览器打开。
不会影响插件的浏览和安装，这些必定会在游戏内浏览器中进行。

entries.source:
Enable Discord's Rich Presence integration to show your current character on your currently playing profile on Discord (restart the game to apply).
#ANTIQUE_WHITE#If you do not use Discord this option doesn't do anything in either state.
entries.target:
开启Discord实时状态可以让你的朋友在Discord上看见你正在玩什么角色（重启游戏后生效）。
#ANTIQUE_WHITE#如果你不使用Discord, 那么这个选项就是无效的。
